entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever! This is completely unacceptable. I need to return an item and your website is useless!
I'm very sorry to hear about your frustrating experience. I can certainly help you with a return. To start, could you tell me your order number?

It's VF-8675309. I bought this jersey a while back and it's the wrong size. If you don't fix this right now, I'm blasting you on every social media platform I can find. I want to speak to your manager!

I understand you're upset, and I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing to escalate. Let me just pull up your order... Okay, I see the ClubFit Jersey, delivered about 45 days ago. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the fit?
I already told you, it's the wrong size! It's way too tight across the chest. I need to exchange it for a larger size or just get my money back. This is ridiculous.
Thank you for clarifying. I just need to check our return policy for that item. One moment, please.
Okay, I've confirmed it. You are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a return or an exchange for you. I apologize for the inconvenience.
Oh. So you can actually help me? You're not going to give me some runaround?
Not at all. I can get this sorted for you right now. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like me to process that exchange for the next size up?
Fine. Let's do the exchange. Just get me the bigger size.

Excellent. I have processed the exchange order for you, and I've just emailed a pre-paid return label for the jersey that was too tight. As soon as you drop that in the mail, we'll ship out the new one.
Okay. I see the email. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a better rest of your day.
